integrity: The proof is analytic and self-contained from the displayed differential equation and boundary conditions. No numerical experiment, unpublished source, or external certification is used.
limitations: The result treats only the additive degenerate exponent \(\gamma=0\) for a two-step weight. It does not classify \(\gamma=p-1\), and the universal oscillation ratio uses the two-step geometry.
title: Explicit completion of the additive degenerate exponent for two-step \(p\)-Laplacian problems
